Ricardo Almeida  
📧 ricardo.almeida@example.com | 📍 Bengaluru, India | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/ricardoalmeida | 🧠 github.com/ricardoalmeida  

A seasoned full-stack developer with 5 years of experience in designing and scaling SaaS platforms. Specialized in building resilient, cloud-native applications with a focus on automation, performance optimization, and developer productivity. Proven ability to bridge technical execution with business outcomes through scalable architectures and robust tooling.  

**Senior Full-Stack Developer**  
*NexaCloud Solutions* (2022–Present)  
Led the development of a serverless-based data analytics platform for enterprise clients, reducing infrastructure costs by 30% through optimized AWS Lambda usage. Spearheaded the migration of monolithic backend systems to microservices, improving deployment frequency by 50% using GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Designed a Python-based data ingestion tool that streamlined client onboarding, cutting setup time by 40%. Collaborated with DevOps teams to implement Dockerized containerization for all microservices, ensuring consistent environments across staging and production.  

**Lead Developer**  
*ApexSoft Ltd.* (2020–2022)  
Architected a real-time collaboration SaaS product using Node.js and React, supporting thousands of concurrent users with low-latency WebSocket integration. Engineered a custom CI/CD pipeline for frontend components, reducing manual testing cycles by 60%. Pioneered the use of Kubernetes for orchestrating backend services, achieving 99.95% SLA compliance. Developed REST APIs with MongoDB for a client management system, enabling seamless integration with third-party tools.  

**Junior Full-Stack Developer**  
*InnovaTech Startup* (2018–2020)  
Contributed to the core development of a SaaS project management tool, focusing on Python-based backend logic and React frontend components. Implemented PostgreSQL-based reporting features that improved data accessibility for end-users. Automated deployment workflows using GitLab CI, reducing release cycles from weeks to hours.  

**Bachelor of Science in Computer Science**  
*University of Lisbon* (2018)  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Python**: Built a scalable data pipeline for client analytics, reducing manual reporting overhead by 70%. Developed internal tools for code quality monitoring, improving team productivity.  
- **AWS**: Deployed serverless architectures for analytics platforms, leveraging S3 and DynamoDB for scalable storage. Managed EC2 clusters for high-availability backend services.  
- **CI/CD pipelines**: Automated deployment workflows for React and Node.js applications, ensuring zero-downtime updates. Integrated testing frameworks for regression validation.  
- **Docker**: Containerized microservices for NexaCloud’s platform, standardizing build processes across development teams.  
- **GitLab CI**: Streamlined frontend builds and backend testing, enabling parallel execution of tasks.  
- **JavaScript**: Developed reusable React components for cross-platform SaaS applications, improving maintainability.  
- **Kubernetes**: Orchestration of containerized services at scale, ensuring dynamic resource allocation.  
- **MongoDB**: Designed NoSQL schemas for real-time collaboration tools, supporting high write-throughput operations.  
- **Node.js**: Built scalable backend services for SaaS products, integrating with REST APIs and gRPC services.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized query performance for client databases, reducing response times by 50% through indexing and caching.  
- **REST API design**: Created scalable endpoints for data synchronization between frontend and backend systems.  
- **React**: Developed responsive UIs for enterprise SaaS applications, focusing on performance and accessibility.  
- **TypeScript**: Enforced type safety in large-scale frontend codebases, reducing runtime errors.  
- **gRPC**: Implemented high-performance service-to-service communication for internal microservices.  

**Languages**  
- English (near-native)  
- Portuguese (fluent)  
- Spanish (basic)
